blocks.x: Booking travel often means navigating fixed prices on flights, hotels, and car rentals—but Priceline has been finding ways around that since 1999. Originally known for its experimental “Name Your Own Price” feature, the platform has evolved into a go-to booking site with access to 28 million properties across 220 countries and territories, plus discounts of up to 60% off hotels, rental cars, cruises, and flights.

I'm always looking for ways to stretch my travel budget a little further, whether I'm booking a spontaneous weekend escape or mapping out a longer trip itinerary. Priceline is one of the first places I check for deals, especially when I can stack on a promo code. From up to 60% off Hotel Express Deals to up to 20% off rental cars and 50% off flights, these Priceline coupons can leave a little more room in the budget for the parts of the trip I'll actually remember.
Use our Priceline coupon code for 10% off outdoor travel

Whether you're planning a romantic escape or a beach trip with friends this summer, you can take 10% off on popular outdoor favorite destinations with code TAKEITOUTSIDE, from select national parks, and coastal cities to mountain towns. Looking for even bigger savings on adventures? If you’re in the market of planning a road trip, take advantage of Priceline’s Great American Road Trip sale. Here, you can score up to $650 off of hotel and flight packages in classic Route 66 cities, destinations with big personalities (from Las Vegas to Austin), desert and southwest hot spots, and more. Additionally, you can take $20 off of hotels and rental cars when you spend $250 with coupon code ROADTRIP.
Save on hotels with Priceline’s Take the PTO sale

What better way to celebrate paid vacation than with a great travel deal? If you book by October 19, you can take advantage of the site's official Take the PTO deal and get $40 off hotel stays of three nights or more (on bookings of $350 and up). Here, you can maximize your vacation days even more with discounted stays on popular cities across the US, from Las Vegas and San Diego to New Orleans and Charleston. All you need to do? Simply use the Priceline promo code TAKETHEPTO at checkout to apply the discount. (Then go have fun, of course.)
Sign up for a 10% off Priceline coupon code and VIP discounts

If you book through Priceline regularly, it's worth signing up for the free Priceline VIP rewards program. Unlike traditional hotel loyalty programs, Priceline VIP rewards your overall booking activity across hotels, rental cars, and more, with each tier unlocking deeper discounts and extra perks.

VIP Member: With a free sign up, join with one simple email that gets you instant access to member pricing, including up to 10% off Express Deals with an eligible promo code for hotel and rental car bookings. It's an easy way to save without committing to a paid membership.

VIP Blue: Once you've completed two eligible trips, you'll unlock VIP Blue status, which includes savings of up to 50% off at more than 15,000 hotels, up to 15% off rental cars when added to an existing trip, and access to additional member-only offers.

VIP Platinum: Frequent Priceline users can reach Platinum status after 25 completed trips. Fun benefits include a fresh 10% off Express Deals coupon after every completed trip, savings of up to 50% at more than 45,000 hotels, enhanced rental car discounts of up to 20%, and additional exclusive member offers.

Compared with other online travel booking rewards programs—such as those from Hotels.com, Vrbo, and Booking.com—Priceline's VIP program stands out for rewarding bookings across multiple travel categories rather than focusing primarily on accommodations, making it a useful option if you regularly bundle different parts of your trip. (Trust me, it's worth it.)
Save up to 55% on Priceline Deals without a promo code

You don't necessarily need a promo code to save on Priceline. Rather its general Deals page rounds up various ways to spend less, including vacation bundles that can save you up to 55% when you combine flights, hotels, and rental cars in one single booking. You can also find deals on popular destinations and up to 20% off featured rental car brands, making it always worth checking the page before you book.
Take up to 60% off on on mystery trips with Priceline Express Deals

For an even bigger discount—and a little more mystery—try Priceline's Express Deals. These offers let you choose your travel dates, destination, preferred star rating, amenities, and price range, but keep the hotel name and exact location hidden until after you book. In exchange for that element of surprise, Priceline can offer significantly discounted rates, with big savings of up to 60%.
https://media.cntraveler.com/photos/68654453daaab05ddac7975c/1:1/w_90%2Cc_limit/File%2520(14).jpg

That said, these fun Express Deals are best for flexible travelers who aren't set on a specific hotel and would rather save than know every detail upfront. The same concept can apply to flights and other travel bookings featured through Priceline's Express Deals offerings, though the exact discounts and availability vary. One important catch: Express Deals are non-refundable, so take note of that prior to booking.
Priceline also offers VIP Deals, which are exclusive offers and benefits for rewards members. Sign in to your Priceline account to see which VIP savings are available to you.
What to expect when you book Priceline Express Deals

Express Deals and VIP Deals offer great savings, but they work a bit differently: Express Deals offer up to a 60% discount automatically on rental car companies, hotels, and flight carriers—but the catch is that you won't know the hotel name until after you book. It's a bit of a mystery with a surprise element attached: travelers select ideal travel dates, location, and general preferences such as star rating, amenities, or price range, but the hotel name and exact location remain hidden until after you book. This allows Priceline to offer you a discounted rate, as hotels can fill their rooms without publicly lowering their prices.

On that note, Express Deals are ideal for travelers who are flexible and open to a bit of mystery in exchange for significant savings. It's a great option if you're not set on a specific hotel and are willing to take a chance on where you'll stay, and for those who value savings over knowing every detail upfront. Though do note, Express Deals are non-refundable. VIP Deals, on the other hand, are exclusive offers available to rewards members, with some discounts and benefits that aren't available to regular users. To view these deals, make sure you're signed into your Priceline account.
Get 50% off your stay with Priceline military discounts

Priceline has partnered with the American Forces Travel (AFT) to offer up to an extra 50% off travel with pre-negotiated rates on flights and hotels. The AFT, supported by Priceline, is the US Department of Defense's official online leisure travel site for active military, Guard or Reserve, US Coast Guard, retired military, and all eligible MWR patrons. Check if you're eligible and complete their authentication process to save on your next trip.
What to know about Priceline promo codes if you want to max out your discount

For your easy reference, there are a few things you’ll want to know before you check out. Priceline promo codes usually have capped discount values, but the brand frequently offers discounts of around $50 or $75 off for hotels, as well as up to $625 off flight and hotel coupons for bundle deals. The most frequent promo codes are for the site’s hotel Express Deals, and new offers are typically released around two to three times per month.

The majority of Priceline promo codes are exclusive to VIP rewards members—and lucky for you, the program is quick and free to join with email sign up. (From there, you'll receive a single-use, unique promo code when you join.) More member perks look like: Saving up to 50% off hotels, rental cars discounts, and early access to sale promos. Do note that the durations of promos vary—sometimes, only lasting 24 hours, and others lasting up to a month.

As Priceline promo codes are often first released to email subscribers and mobile app users, you'll want to download the app and turn on notifications so you don't miss a beat. Time your booking right by following along on Condé Nast Traveler for exclusive discounts. For more information, most terms and conditions can be found on their website.
What to do if your Priceline promo code isn’t working

If your Priceline promo code isn't working, don't assume it's invalid and give up—most codes come with a handful of restrictions. Double-check that the code hasn't expired, that it's valid for the type of booking you're making, and that you've met any minimum spend or eligibility requirements. Some discounts apply only to Express Deals, while others are limited to hotels, rental cars, or select flights, and many can't be combined with another promotion or automatically discounted rate.

It's also worth quickly confirming that you're signed in to the correct Priceline account, especially if you're trying to redeem a VIP-exclusive offer, as many member discounts are tied to your account rather than available at checkout for everyone. If everything looks right and the code still won't apply, removing and re-adding your booking or trying a different browser or device can sometimes resolve the temporary issue. And if all else fails, Priceline's customer support can confirm whether the promotion is still active or help identify why it isn't applying to your reservation.
